title: Baseline Vitest loads Playwright e2e specs incorrectly
description: Baseline npm test -- --run fails before Bao Com cutoff implementation because Vitest imports Playwright tests under tests/e2e/*.spec.ts. Error: Playwright Test did not expect test() to be called here. Affected files include auth-flows.spec.ts, authorization.spec.ts, booking-dashboard.spec.ts, idor.spec.ts, meals-holidays.spec.ts, and security.spec.ts. Vitest config should exclude Playwright specs or e2e files should use a different pattern/test command.
close_reason: Fixed by excluding tests/e2e from Vitest; full Vitest suite no longer loads Playwright specs

title: Baseline Vitest fails without JWT_SECRET
description: Baseline npm test -- --run fails before Bao Com cutoff implementation. Affected files: tests/controllers/UsersController.test.ts and tests/services/UserService.test.ts. Error: JWT_SECRET environment variable is required from src/lib/auth.ts:7. Decide whether test setup should provide JWT_SECRET or auth module should be mocked in these tests.
close_reason: Fixed by setting JWT_SECRET in Vitest setup; affected tests now pass

title: Baseline rate limiter tests fail
description: Baseline npm test -- --run fails before Bao Com cutoff implementation in tests/lib/rateLimiter.test.ts. Failures: should track failed attempts gets state.attempts undefined; should lock IP after max attempts expects allowed false but gets true; should reset attempts after window expiry cannot set lastAttempt because state is undefined. Investigate InMemoryRateLimiter state tracking versus test expectations.
close_reason: Fixed by letting InMemoryRateLimiter logic run in unit tests; rate limiter tests now pass
